product_title: Handcrafted Golden Rope Floral Tealight Holder Set
product_description: Elevate your festive decor with this handcrafted set featuring a golden braided base, elegant pearl borders, rich red roses, and a stylish tealight holder. Perfect for Diwali, pooja decor, festive tables, and special occasions.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep flowers and pearl embellishments away from water and harsh chemicals.
Keep decorative flowers away from direct heat and open flames.
Use LED tealights for safer lighting, or ensure candle flames do not touch the decorations.
Store in a dry, protective box when not in use.
